title: Admit the reviewed AMP demonstration dataset
summary: The program lead (palerdr) accepted direction and alternating-tripod appearance in all 40 native clips. The exporter wrote 18000 transition pairs, 900 per phase-zero command, with the hash-bound review and manifest under locomotion/priors/datasets/amp_demonstrations_001. CI now runs dataset check on the committed bank, and source manifest v10 binds the changed workflow and checker. This acceptance covers dataset admission; Stage 2 qualification stays incomplete.
next: AMP learning under issue #37 can use the admitted bank. Stage 2 still needs the full direction, transition, stop, motor and contact suite.
